assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: one finished landscape 3:2 collection-card cover for the Litwalls poster shop. Input image 1 is a STYLE reference for the existing approved collection covers: match the same overhead studio view, warm charcoal textured matte paper surface, amber light in the top left fading to almost black to the right, narrow ivory paper edges and realistic soft paper shadows. Keep the same premium, restrained photographic presentation. Replace ALL gaming artwork from image 1. The remaining images are actual product mockups: take ONLY the printed poster artwork from them, discard their rooms, walls, desks, plants and furniture. Preserve the artwork's original colors, composition, subjects, lettering and proportions faithfully. Every paper corner must remain inside the frame with comfortable breathing room. No frames, curling paper, gloss, extra objects, store logos, prices, category labels or any new typography. The artwork fills about 80% of canvas width and 76% of its height. Collection: Motivational. Exactly three portrait prints, arranged just like image 1: left smaller tilted -11 degrees uses image 2 (Bruce Lee in black martial arts clothing against muted gray-green, with existing 'MASTER YOUR MIND' lettering); center larger almost upright tilted -2 degrees uses image 3 (overhead runner on a rust-brown track, cream lettering 'Motivation fades.' then large 'DISCIPLINE' then 'Shows up anyway.'); right smaller tilted +11 degrees uses image 4 (moody warm gray cloudscape with a lone street lamp, pale yellow existing lettering 'CAN’T BE GOOD ALL THE TIME'). The center print overlaps the side prints slightly but all original headlines and key subjects remain clearly visible. Spell the original poster text exactly and keep it fully inside its own print. Use the real catalogue artwork, no extra quotes or replacement subjects. Cohesive warm black, muted sage and rust palette. No gaming images.
